_leeme: The English texts of the Extras menu (v1.94). Same shape as programa/extras.json; only the texts. Each entry keeps its id (or img) so it can be checked against the Spanish one. Anything missing falls back to Spanish.

personajes.archivo: SUBJECT CRIO-01. Crew member in prolonged hibernation. The freezing process was never completed. Pod readings show constant brain activity throughout the sleep. Keep the temperature within range. Do not open the pod under any circumstances.
SUBJECT LAB-07. Result of the laboratory experiments. Tissue from several donors stitched together. Has a working third arm and a smile it cannot close. Responds to sound. Classified as aggressive.

personajes.alias: also known as the Long One
personajes.archivo: UNKNOWN SUBJECT. Not listed in the crew register. Too tall for the ship's corridors: it walks hunched over and its head brushes the ceiling lights. Destroyed the camera system of the control module. Always smiling.

SUBJECT INV-03. Originated in the greenhouse. Moves across floors, walls and ceilings. Sensitive to the system update and to insecticide gas. Its mouth is a ring of teeth. Do not leave the console without updating it.

UNCLASSIFIED SUBJECT. Looks like an ordinary crew member. It does not walk: it changes position between frames. Interferes with the cameras when watched for too long. Avoid holding its gaze. Some guards reported they kept seeing it after looking away.

CREW MEMBER (THE UNIFORM READS «TEC. RIVAS»). Only the upper half of the body remains. Moves through the ventilation ducts, dragging itself with its arms. Able to break the office vents. Flees from direct light.
UNCATALOGUED ORGANISM. Gelatinous, translucent, gives off its own light. Shows no aggression. Sensitive to cold. Seems to have grown fond of the night guard.
personajes.archivoMuerto: UNCATALOGUED ORGANISM. Gelatinous, translucent, used to give off its own light. Sensitive to cold. Found frozen next to the control module corridor. It no longer glows.

personajes.triangulo: black with a dark red border
personajes.archivo: EXPERIMENT 0. The ship's first subject, sealed behind the laboratory wall. A mass made of the failed cryogenics crew, fused together. Moves on human arms. Several of the faces are still alive. The other subjects obey it. One of the faces does not appear in any record.

sustos.aviso: Contains jumpscares with loud sound and violence

lista.donde: Comes out of its broken vent
It grabs you and eats you

retos.extra: No flashlight. Only cameras and sound.
The cameras are broken from 12:00 (like Night 3 from 3 AM on).
No reactor cooldowns, but it heats up 20 % less.
No alert triangles. Only sound and the terminal.
If you look at The Wanderer even once on the cameras, you lose.
The Cryogenics temperature margin is halved.
Limited audio lures and insecticide: 10 lures and 8 releases for the whole night.
Both office vents are broken from 12:00.
The doors take 1 s to close.
Every hour the system asks for «get-update» and you have 10 s to type it.
Everything runs at double speed: the night lasts half as long, but the enemies move twice as fast.
Everyone at maximum. No extra: that's enough.
